tools.name: analyze_trend
tools.description: Analyze whether a metric, theme, or issue is increasing, decreasing, or changing over time in available InfiniteWatch data.

topic.description: Metric, theme, or question to trend, for example "unresolved calls".

domain.description: Domain to inspect. Use all for cross-domain trends.

dateRange.description: Natural language or explicit date range, for example "July 2026".

tools.name: ask_how_to
tools.description: Ask for grounded operational guidance or next-step handling based on InfiniteWatch data. If the request is internal policy that InfiniteWatch cannot know, the answer should say so safely.

domain.description: Optional product scope for the question.

tools.name: ask_infinitewatch
tools.description: Ask InfiniteWatch a grounded question about customer interactions, insights, examples, trends, comparisons, or diagnostics.

prompt.description: Plain-language question to answer using InfiniteWatch data.

productScope.description: Optional product scope. Use all for available cross-domain data.

conversationId.description: Optional persisted global-chat conversation id for follow-up context.

context.description: Optional dashboard context such as selected call/text/web id or filters.

selectedEntityId.description: Selected dashboard entity id, such as a voice call id, text conversation id, or web session id.

selectedEntityType.description: Selected entity type, for example voice-call or text-conversation.

dateRange.description: Natural language or explicit date range, for example "July 2026".

availableDomains.description: Product domains available to this organization or request.

pagePath.description: Dashboard path that provides page context.

pageTitle.description: Dashboard page title that provides page context.

tools.name: compare_channels
tools.description: Compare results, issues, trends, or priorities across available InfiniteWatch channels.

prompt.description: Comparison request, for example "Compare voice and text issues in July".

dateRange.description: Natural language or explicit date range, for example "July 2026".

tools.name: diagnose_issue
tools.description: Explain likely drivers behind an issue, poor outcome, escalation risk, low QA, or other diagnostic question.

issue.description: Issue or diagnostic question to investigate.

domain.description: Domain to inspect. Use all for cross-domain diagnostics.

dateRange.description: Natural language or explicit date range, for example "July 2026".

tools.name: get_examples
tools.description: Find direct examples from available InfiniteWatch interactions for a theme, issue, insight, agent, or outcome.

theme.description: Theme or issue to find evidence for.

domain.description: Domain to search. Defaults to all available domains.

dateRange.description: Natural language or explicit date range, for example "July 2026".

tools.name: get_insights
tools.description: Get top or important insights from the selected or available InfiniteWatch data.

domain.description: Domain to inspect. Defaults to all available domains.

dateRange.description: Natural language or explicit date range, for example "July 2026".

focus.description: Optional focus such as high impact, new, unresolved, QA, or support priorities.

tools.name: iw_webmcp_authorize
tools.description: Request an OAuth authorization link for this page's MCP. Ask the user before opening the link in this same tab. The user completes sign-in and consent; no dashboard connection button is needed.

tools.name: iw_webmcp_disconnect
tools.description: Revoke this tab's MCP authorization when the user asks to disconnect or change accounts/organizations. Public tool discovery remains available.

tools.name: summarize_interaction
tools.description: Summarize or answer a question about one selected InfiniteWatch interaction.

interactionId.description: Voice call id, text conversation id, or web session/replay id.

question.description: Optional specific question, for example "Was this resolved?".
